annotations.title: Find the nearest accessible color that passes contrast

description: Use when a color pair fails contrast and the user wants the smallest change that makes it pass, such as "make this gray text accessible without changing the look". Returns the closest text color on that background that reaches the target (AA, AAA, AA-large or ui), and separately the closest background, keeping the hue. Example: {"foreground": "#777777", "background": "#ffffff", "target": "AA"}. Returns already_passes if nothing needs to change.
name: swatch_fix_contrast
title: Find the nearest accessible color that passes contrast
